## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-08-18 — do not edit manually*

### Large Files
*~1,250,000 tokens/session saved*
- Re-read loops on these files wasted >1.2M tokens: `src/App.tsx` (311 re-reads), `src-tauri/src/tool_manager.rs` (249), `state.rs` (213), `proxy_intercept.rs` (209), `client_adapters.rs` (182), `lib.rs` (158), `pricing.rs` (68), plus `models.rs`, `logging.rs`, `activity_facts.rs`, `src/styles.css`, `src/lib/appHelpers.ts`. NEVER full-read (Read hard cap ~25k tokens; full reads also ERROR(timeout)) — grep for the symbol, Read ONE offset/limit window, and keep the line numbers in your notes instead of re-reading the same region later in the session.
- After an Edit failure, re-Read only a narrow window around the edit site, never the whole file.
- Same rule in `headroom-web`: `app/models/user.rb`, `app/assets/stylesheets/application.css`, and `app/views/site/home.html.erb` showed identical re-read loops (~26k tokens).

### Installed Python Runtime (venv package)
*~220,000 tokens/session saved*
- Backend runtime source is `~/Library/Application Support/Headroom/headroom/runtime/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/headroom/`. Shell state does NOT persist between Bash calls — a `P=<venv path>` assignment dies with the call. ~220k tokens/session were burned re-assigning path variables (`HR=`, `P=`, `PKG=`, `HB=`, `V=`, ...) and re-slicing the same files.
- Batch ALL greps/seds for one investigation into a single Bash call, or use the Read tool with the absolute path and cover the whole region in one read.

### Build & Check Commands
*~14,000 tokens/session saved*
- **Do not use `cd src-tauri && cargo ...`** — always the manifest-path form: `cargo check|test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml 2>&1 | tail -30`. `cargo test <a> <b>` fails (pass ONE regex filter); `cargo fmt -- src/foo.rs` resolves paths from CWD — pass `src-tauri/src/foo.rs` or omit file args.
- Iterate with SCOPED tests (`cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib <module>::`, `bin/rails test test/<specific>_test.rb`); run the full `--lib` suite / full `bin/rails test` ONCE before commit — full-suite runs were repeated 16–17x in single sessions.

### Inspecting Files at a Git Ref
*~10,000 tokens/session saved*
- To inspect a file at a ref, dump it ONCE (`git show upstream/main:path > $SCRATCHPAD/file`) and grep/read the local copy — repeated `git show ref:path | grep ...` slices of the same file looped 9x (~10k tokens wasted).

### Environment
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- **RTK `command not found`:** Bash commands are auto-rewritten to `rtk <cmd>`, but `rtk` is only on PATH inside `headroom-desktop`. In `headroom-web`, or after any `Shell cwd was reset` notice, they fail with `(eval):1: command not found: rtk`. Use absolute binaries (`/bin/ls`, `/usr/bin/find`, `/usr/bin/grep`, `/usr/bin/wc`, `/usr/bin/env gh`); for headroom-web Ruby use `bin/rails`/`bin/brakeman` or rbenv `~/.rbenv/versions/3.4.8/bin/bundle` (plain `bundle`/`command bundle` still hit the rtk wrapper).
- **`grep` is ripgrep AND the `Grep` tool is unavailable:** always run `grep` via Bash (the Grep tool errors `No such tool available`). Unescaped `(` → `rg: regex parse error / unclosed group` — escape or simplify the pattern; quote globs as `--include='*.rs'` (bare `--include=*.rs` triggers zsh `no matches found`).
- **`find` rejects `-not`/`-exec`** (use Glob or `/usr/bin/find`); **`rtk proxy <cmd> 2>&1 | tail` fails** because `2>&1` is parsed as an arg — drop the redirect.

### Headroom Python repo (uv)
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*
- In `/Users/garmlucassen/Code/headroom/`, run code/tests with `uv run`; dev tools need the dev EXTRA: `uv run --extra dev pytest|mypy` (NOT `--group dev`, which errors `Group dev is not defined`). Lint/format with `uvx ruff check|format` (`ruff` is not on PATH directly).
- `uv.lock` frequently carries merge-conflict markers that break EVERY `uv` command (`Failed to parse uv.lock ... key with no value`); run `uv lock` or `git checkout -- uv.lock` before any `uv run`.

### Release Notes Path
*~800 tokens/session saved*
- CORRECTION (supersedes the earlier "directory does not exist" note): `.github/release-notes/X.Y.Z.md` DOES exist and is part of the desktop release flow. Write the notes file for the new version, then run `./scripts/bump-version.sh X.Y.Z < /dev/null` (the script reads stdin — without `< /dev/null` it hangs), `git add -A`, commit `X.Y.Z`, push.
- `Write` on a new `release-notes/*.md` still requires a prior `Read` if the file already exists, else it fails `File has not been read yet`.

### Ports & Proxy Layout
*~800 tokens/session saved*
- 6767 = always-on Tauri intercept proxy (Rust); 6768 = managed headroom Python backend started by tool_manager. Never collapse the two — `headroom_proxy_reachable`/health checks should hit 6768 (backend), public stats endpoints are on 6767.
- The backend port is configurable via `backend_port.rs`; treat 6768 as the default, not a hard-coded constant when reading new code.

### Git: staging branch vs tag
*~800 tokens/session saved*
- A `staging` tag and `staging` branch both exist. `git push origin staging` fails with `src refspec staging matches more than one`. Always use the explicit refspec: `git push origin refs/heads/staging:refs/heads/staging`.
- Same issue applies to `git tag -d staging` / creating branches prefixed `staging/` (conflicts with `refs/heads/staging`).

### Python / JSON parsing
*~600 tokens/session saved*
- `python3` in Bash resolves to system Python 3.9 (from Xcode) which fails on modern JSON payloads (`Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes`). Use `/usr/bin/python3` only for simple parsing, and prefer `uv run python` from the `/Users/garmlucassen/Code/headroom/` repo when modern Python features are needed.

### Subagents
*~5,000 tokens/session saved*
- The user frequently rejects subagent (Explore) calls when Claude initiates them autonomously. Prefer doing direct Grep/Read/Glob exploration inline rather than spawning subagents unless the task clearly warrants it.

### Edit Tool Rules
*~2,500 tokens/session saved*
- Always `Read` a file before attempting to `Edit` it — editing without a prior read will fail with 'File has not been read yet'
- After an external linter modifies a file, re-read before editing again to avoid 'File has been modified since read' errors
